data-model.text: Fields, relationships, validation and state invariants of the new or changed data. Signatures are in the functions model; responsibilities in the modules model. Output ceiling: 6 KB.

the-model-pull-requests-1-and-2.text: Pull request 1 carries the created holdings and the changed batch verdict; pull request 2 carries the request field, the fold witness and the fold admission verdict.

State invariants. A fold's admission reads no registry state beyond the configuration's processing time. Inside the window a fold is exactly the law it was before. A batch accepted by the model burns only holdings that existed in the state it started from. A reject is admitted in any window.

builder-and-receipt-pull-request-3.text: Reason names by source after this ticket: model refusal gains not-phase1; selection policy loses window-closed and keeps undecodable, application-datum-unreadable, key-in-batch, capacity.

validator-evidence-pull-request-4.text: State invariants. Every refused case has an accepted twin that differs in the one mutated field. Counts of exported contexts are derived from the discovered labels, not typed.
